lessons.title: Qu'est-ce qu'une galerie?
lessons.oneGoal: Students will understand the purpose and function of art galleries

opening.activity: Virtual gallery tour using photos or videos of famous galleries. Compare to other spaces students know: stores, libraries, theaters. Introduce vocabulary: GALERIE (showcase gesture), EXPOSITION (displaying motion), VISITEUR (walking/looking gesture).

materials: Simple artworks or posters for display

closing.activity: Gallery Visitor Practice. Students take turns being visitors in their mock gallery. Practice appropriate behavior and vocabulary: 'Je visite la galerie.' 'Je regarde l'exposition.' Discuss what makes a good gallery experience.

troubleshooting.then: Gallery exploration through pictures: Use art books or online gallery tours to explore gallery concepts, practice vocabulary through virtual visits.

lessons.realWorldConnection: Visiting museums, art shows, looking at displays in libraries or community centers

lessons.title: Rôles dans une galerie
lessons.oneGoal: Students will identify different roles people play in gallery operations

opening.activity: Role-play different gallery jobs using simple props. Show what each person does. Introduce vocabulary: CONSERVATEUR (organizing/selecting gesture), GUIDE (leading/explaining motion), ARTISTE (creating gesture).

materials: Role-play props (clipboard for curator, badge for guide, art supplies for artist)

closing.activity: Gallery Team Introduction. Students introduce themselves in their chosen gallery roles: 'Je suis conservateur/guide/artiste.' Explain what their job will be in classroom gallery. Practice professional vocabulary.

troubleshooting.then: Gallery job study: Use pictures and videos to study different gallery jobs, practice vocabulary without role-play activities.

lessons.realWorldConnection: Understanding different jobs people do, like teachers, doctors, store workers

lessons.title: Sélection d'œuvres
lessons.oneGoal: Students will learn to curate and select artworks for exhibition

opening.activity: Present large collection of student artwork from previous units. Discuss how to choose which pieces to display. Introduce vocabulary: SÉLECTIONNER (choosing gesture), QUALITÉ (thumbs up quality), THÈME (grouping gesture).

closing.activity: Curatorial Presentations. Student curators present their selections and explain choices: 'J'ai sélectionné ces œuvres parce qu'elles montrent...' Discuss different curatorial approaches.

troubleshooting.then: Selection practice with art reproductions: Practice curatorial selection using famous artworks or art book images, focusing on vocabulary and selection criteria.

lessons.realWorldConnection: Choosing photos for albums, selecting clothes to wear, picking favorite books

lessons.title: Présentation et affichage
lessons.oneGoal: Students will learn effective methods for displaying artwork

opening.activity: Compare well-displayed art to poorly displayed art using examples. Discuss how presentation affects viewing experience. Introduce vocabulary: AFFICHER (hanging/displaying motion), CADRE (frame outline gesture), ÉCLAIRAGE (light gesture).

closing.activity: Display Quality Assessment. Students evaluate different artwork displays and suggest improvements. Practice vocabulary: 'Cet affichage pourrait être amélioré avec...' Focus on helpful, constructive suggestions.

troubleshooting.then: Display planning on paper: Plan artwork displays using drawings and layouts, practice vocabulary without physical hanging and arrangement.

lessons.realWorldConnection: Arranging their bedroom, setting table for dinner, organizing school supplies

lessons.title: Étiquettes et information
lessons.oneGoal: Students will create informative labels and descriptions for artworks

opening.activity: Examine labels from various contexts: food labels, museum labels, store signs. Discuss what makes labels helpful vs confusing. Introduce vocabulary: ÉTIQUETTE (label pointing), DESCRIPTION (explaining gesture), INFORMATION (sharing knowledge motion).

closing.activity: Label Testing. Students read each other's labels and provide feedback: 'Cette étiquette m'aide à comprendre...' Test label clarity and helpfulness from visitor perspective.

troubleshooting.then: Label analysis without creation: Study effective labels from museums or books, practice vocabulary through label evaluation and discussion.

lessons.realWorldConnection: Reading labels in stores, signs at zoo, instructions for games

lessons.title: Parcours de visite
lessons.oneGoal: Students will design logical pathways for gallery visitors

opening.activity: Walk through classroom following different pathways. Notice how route affects experience. Introduce vocabulary: PARCOURS (pathway tracing), SÉQUENCE (ordering gesture), FLUX (flowing movement).

closing.activity: Pathway Testing. Students follow designed pathways and evaluate visitor experience. Practice vocabulary: 'Ce parcours crée une bonne séquence parce que...' Make adjustments based on testing.

troubleshooting.then: Pathway planning on paper: Design gallery pathways using floor plan drawings, practice vocabulary through planning without physical testing.

lessons.realWorldConnection: Following paths in parks, routes through stores, order of activities in their day

lessons.title: Vernissage et inauguration
lessons.oneGoal: Students will plan and execute a gallery opening event

opening.activity: Learn about gallery opening traditions. Show photos of vernissages and art openings. Introduce vocabulary: VERNISSAGE (celebration gesture), INVITÉ (welcoming gesture), CÉLÉBRATION (party/joy motion).

closing.activity: Opening Event Rehearsal. Practice welcoming guests, explaining gallery, conducting opening ceremony. Practice vocabulary: 'Bienvenue à notre vernissage!' Prepare for actual opening.

troubleshooting.then: Opening event planning only: Plan gallery opening using templates and discussion, practice vocabulary without full preparation if time or resources are limited.

lessons.realWorldConnection: Birthday parties, school concerts, family gatherings

lessons.title: Visite guidée
lessons.oneGoal: Students will conduct guided tours of their gallery

opening.activity: Experience difference between self-guided and guided gallery visits. Practice basic tour guide techniques. Introduce vocabulary: GUIDE (leading gesture), EXPLIQUER (explanation motion), PRÉSENTER (presentation gesture).

closing.activity: Tour Guide Evaluation. Students evaluate each other's tours using constructive feedback. Practice vocabulary: 'Ce guide explique bien parce que...' Plan improvements for real visitor tours.

troubleshooting.then: Tour planning without execution: Plan gallery tours using scripts and route maps, practice vocabulary through planning without actual tour conduct.

lessons.realWorldConnection: Showing friends their room, explaining games to others, teaching family members new things

lessons.title: Critique et évaluation
lessons.oneGoal: Students will gather and respond to feedback about their gallery

opening.activity: Discuss difference between helpful criticism and hurtful comments. Practice giving and receiving constructive feedback. Introduce vocabulary: CRITIQUE (analytical thinking), AMÉLIORATION (improvement gesture), FEEDBACK (response/sharing motion).

materials: Comment books or digital feedback tools

closing.activity: Improvement Implementation. Begin implementing planned improvements based on feedback. Practice vocabulary: 'Grâce à la critique, nous améliorons...' Celebrate willingness to grow and improve.

troubleshooting.then: Feedback analysis simulation: Use hypothetical feedback to practice evaluation and improvement planning, focus on vocabulary without real visitor feedback.

lessons.realWorldConnection: Getting suggestions from friends, teacher feedback on work, family advice

lessons.title: Art français célèbre
lessons.oneGoal: Students will explore famous French artworks and artists

opening.activity: Introduce famous French artists and artworks using reproductions. Compare to student artwork in their gallery. Introduce vocabulary: CÉLÈBRE (fame gesture), FRANÇAIS (France connection), PATRIMOINE (heritage/treasure gesture).

closing.activity: French Art Appreciation. Students choose favorite French artwork and explain why it appeals to them. Practice vocabulary: 'J'aime cet art français célèbre parce que...' Connect to their gallery.

troubleshooting.then: French art study through books and digital resources: Explore French art using available resources, practice vocabulary through visual analysis without hands-on activities.

lessons.realWorldConnection: Learning about their country's history, famous people from their area

lessons.title: Techniques françaises traditionnelles
lessons.oneGoal: Students will try traditional French artistic techniques

opening.activity: Explore traditional French art techniques: impressionist brushwork, pastels, simple printmaking. Connect to famous French artists studied. Introduce vocabulary: TRADITIONNEL (heritage gesture), TECHNIQUE (skill demonstration), HÉRITAGE (passing down motion).

closing.activity: Traditional Technique Showcase. Students present artwork created using traditional French techniques. Practice vocabulary: 'J'ai utilisé cette technique traditionnelle pour créer...' Connect to cultural heritage.

troubleshooting.then: Traditional technique study: Study traditional French techniques through examples and demonstrations, practice vocabulary without hands-on technique practice.

lessons.realWorldConnection: Learning traditional recipes, games, or crafts from their own family

lessons.title: Galerie virtuelle
lessons.oneGoal: Students will create digital documentation of their gallery

opening.activity: Explore virtual galleries online. Compare virtual to physical gallery experiences. Introduce vocabulary: VIRTUEL (digital gesture), NUMÉRIQUE (technology motion), DOCUMENTATION (recording/saving gesture).

closing.activity: Virtual Gallery Sharing. Present digital gallery to others. Discuss how virtual galleries can reach more people. Practice vocabulary: 'Notre documentation numérique permet de partager...'

troubleshooting.then: Virtual gallery planning without creation: Plan digital gallery organization and content, practice vocabulary through planning without actual digital creation.

lessons.realWorldConnection: Taking photos to share with family, video calls with distant relatives

lessons.title: Échange avec d'autres galeries
lessons.oneGoal: Students will connect with other classroom galleries or art spaces

opening.activity: Discuss how museums and galleries collaborate and share exhibitions. Plan connections with other classrooms or local art spaces. Introduce vocabulary: ÉCHANGE (exchange/sharing gesture), PARTAGER (giving/sharing motion), COLLABORATION (working together gesture).

closing.activity: Exchange Reflection. Reflect on what was learned through exchange or collaboration. Practice vocabulary: 'Grâce à cet échange, nous avons appris...' Plan future collaborations.

troubleshooting.then: Collaboration planning and simulation: Plan gallery exchanges using hypothetical scenarios, practice vocabulary through planning without actual exchanges.

lessons.realWorldConnection: Pen pals, visiting other classrooms, community connections

lessons.title: Évolution de la galerie
lessons.oneGoal: Students will plan how their gallery will change and grow over time

opening.activity: Discuss how galleries change over time: new exhibitions, growing collections, facility improvements. Plan gallery future. Introduce vocabulary: ÉVOLUTION (growth/change motion), CHANGEMENT (transformation gesture), CROISSANCE (expansion gesture).

closing.activity: Gallery Future Presentation. Students present plans for gallery evolution and growth. Practice vocabulary: 'Pour l'évolution future, nous planifions...' Commit to realistic next steps.

troubleshooting.then: Gallery future planning through discussion: Plan gallery evolution using discussion and planning sheets, practice vocabulary without implementation commitments.

lessons.realWorldConnection: How their room changes as they grow, family traditions that evolve

lessons.title: Célébration finale
lessons.oneGoal: Students will celebrate their gallery achievements and plan future artistic endeavors

opening.activity: Reflect on gallery journey from first lesson to final exhibition. Celebrate growth and achievements. Introduce vocabulary: CÉLÉBRATION (celebration gesture), ACCOMPLISSEMENT (achievement motion), FUTUR (forward-looking gesture).

closing.activity: Future Artistic Commitment. Students commit to continuing artistic growth beyond gallery project. Practice 'futur' vocabulary: 'Dans le futur, je continuerai l'art en...' Connect to lifelong learning.

troubleshooting.then: Celebration planning and reflection: Plan celebration activities and reflect on achievements through discussion, practice vocabulary without large celebration event.

lessons.realWorldConnection: Graduation ceremonies, end-of-season celebrations, family milestones
